basis: Defined by glomerular protein loss and nephrotic syndrome; immune causation is not established across this umbrella.
Epidermal nevi and neurodevelopmental abnormalities define this neurocutaneous syndrome; ocular abnormalities are insufficiently frequent.
Photosensitive brittle-hair disorder with characteristic intellectual and developmental impairment; ocular damage and immune deficiency lack reliable >=30% evidence.
Central autonomic ventilatory failure defines the syndrome; respiratory failure occurs in 2/2. Constipation and episodic hypertension do not establish additional organ injury.
Benign smooth-muscle tumour arising in the colorectal wall.
Developmental disability and epilepsy predominate; skeletal malformations and cleft palate occur in 80-99%; cataract, microphthalmia and coloboma in 30-79%.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising in chest-wall structures; lymphoma supplies the immune mechanism axis.
Kyphoscoliosis, joint instability and skin fragility characterize kEDS; hypermetropia occurs in 30-79%. Arterial events and hearing impairment are not established at >=30%.
Gas bubbles obstruct vessels and occupy periarticular tissues; neurologic injury occurs in roughly 30-50%, varying substantially by case series.
TPM1-associated hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is a myocardial disease.
Neoplasm arising exclusively from joint synovium or tendon-sheath synovial tissue.
Postinfectious SARS-CoV-2 disease umbrella; no specific organ has established direct injury in >=30% across its heterogeneous subtypes.
The supplied definition identifies cutaneous schistosome deposition with inflammatory dermatitis.
Immune-mediated inflammatory optic neuropathy; optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis. Other neurologic or systemic disease is excluded by definition.
Bile-duct paucity, intellectual disability and meatal atresia define disease; clubfeet are defining skeletal defects. VSD and low immunoglobulins (30-79%) omitted by cap.
Combined immune-cell functional deficiency defines disease. Reported pneumonia, esophagitis, osteomyelitis and cholangitis are separately diagnosed infectious complications.
Progressive acquired generalized skin hyperpigmentation without other systemic manifestations.
Scalp aplasia and external-ear hypoplasia define disease; renal insufficiency 5/15 and cataract 30-79%. Dental defects and syndactyly omitted by cap; diabetes is separate.
Inherited phosphate-regulation disorder defined by periarticular and subcutaneous calcific masses and/or painful cortical hyperostosis.
Cortical malformations, intellectual disability and seizures define disease; visual impairment 2/7 lacks established ocular localization. Isolated allergy is separate.
Microcephaly, intellectual disability and vertebral fusion define disease; ureter defects and ptosis occur in 30-79%. Dental anomalies omitted by cap; reticulocyte shape alone excluded.
Congenital complete atrioventricular septal defect with ventricular hypoplasia.
Severe short-rib skeletal dysplasia; pulmonary hypoplasia with respiratory failure affects most and drives neonatal lethality. Renal-malformation frequency is uncertain.
Proximal tubular dysfunction and endocrine dysregulation define disease; rickets and hepatomegaly with elevated transaminases each reported in 1/1; prevalence evidence is sparse.
Necrolytic inflammatory acral skin disease; associated hepatitis C is a separate disease, and zinc responsiveness alone does not establish a metabolic disorder.
